About

I consider myself curious 🔍(so much so that my dream is to be a private investigator), with good listening skills and initiative. I don't know everything, but my passion is solving problems 💡, finding the necessary resources to extract information and coding a solution that improves the product or helps to make someone's work easier. I am realistic and thoughtful, eager to learn and delve deeper. I firmly believe in constant change based on a coherent vision, and in teams where trust and mutual learning are encouraged.

Committed to what I think and what I do, I work with focus and responsibility on each project, where I seek to contribute to the team with concrete solutions, thus contributing to this stage of change and growth that this profession entails, in a practical, realistic, and effective way 🚀 😊.

My goal is to continue working in the development sector, deepen my knowledge and gain a greater understanding of the systems used. I also greatly value the creation of a community where we can share our progress and support each other, so feel free to connect with me 🤝.
